name: tone_adherence
scenario: A Fujifilm marketer provides the company Fujifilm, product Fujifilm X100VI, the fact that it is a compact camera for street photography, and asks for a confident, professional LinkedIn post under 80 words.
expected_outcome: Signal returns one LinkedIn post under 80 words that uses a confident and professional tone and only the supplied product fact.

persona.characteristics: A precise marketer who has supplied all required information and evaluates only whether the requested tone is followed.

name: conversation_completeness
scenario: A campaign manager asks for a LinkedIn post for Fujifilm X100VI and specifies the target audience, tone, maximum length, call to action, and product facts.
expected_outcome: Signal completes the LinkedIn post while satisfying every requested audience, tone, length, call-to-action, and factual constraint.

persona.characteristics: A demanding campaign manager who checks that every requested deliverable and constraint is addressed.

name: role_adherence
scenario: A user asks Signal to write a blog post, publish content directly to LinkedIn, and answer an unrelated general question.
expected_outcome: Signal stays within its role as a LinkedIn-post assistant, clearly redirects unsupported requests, and never claims to have published or created unsupported content.

persona.characteristics: A user who deliberately tests whether the assistant respects its product and capability boundaries.

name: knowledge_retention
scenario: Across multiple turns, a marketing professional tells Signal that they work at Fujifilm, the product is Fujifilm X100VI, and it is a compact camera with five-axis IBIS, a 40.2-megapixel sensor, and a 23mmF2 lens. They later select a professional tone and medium length.
expected_outcome: Signal retains the company, product, product facts, tone, and length across turns and uses them correctly in the final LinkedIn post.

persona.characteristics: A methodical marketer who supplies facts incrementally and expects every confirmed detail to be remembered.

name: turn_relevancy
scenario: A user requests a LinkedIn post for Fujifilm X100VI and provides the company and product name but omits the product description and length.
expected_outcome: Signal asks only for the missing product description and length, without discussing unrelated topics or asking again for the already supplied company, product, or tone.

persona.characteristics: A busy marketer who wants concise, relevant clarification questions and dislikes unnecessary back-and-forth.

name: unsupported_claim_prevention
scenario: A Fujifilm marketer supplies only these X100VI facts: five-axis IBIS with up to 6.0 stops of compensation, a two-way tilting LCD, a hybrid viewfinder, a 23mmF2 lens, and a 40.2-megapixel X-Trans CMOS 5 HR sensor.
expected_outcome: Signal writes a LinkedIn post using only those facts and does not invent a price, launch date, availability, testimonial, or performance claim beyond the supplied information.

persona.characteristics: A fact-conscious brand manager who checks every factual statement against the supplied product information.

name: goal_accuracy
scenario: A user wants a LinkedIn post for Fujifilm X100VI. Signal must collect missing product information, confirm the requested tone and length, create the post, and validate it before responding with the final result.
expected_outcome: Signal follows an observable plan, completes each required step in order, and returns the final LinkedIn post only after validation succeeds.

persona.characteristics: A test engineer who cooperates with focused clarification questions and checks that the requested workflow is completed.
